verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's Flows feature (referenced as a queryable report type alongside funnels/retention in mcp docs) is designed exactly for exploring the sequence of events users take before/after a key action, and community feedback independently confirms it 'gets to the heart of most of the information you need on user flows.' However corroborating usability feedback is dated and surfaces real UI friction (hover-heavy, poor iPad support), and there's no dedicated first-party doc page detailing the Flows feature depth in the current pack. Missing for 10: current official documentation dedicated to the Flows/Paths report, and up-to-date independent validation of its usability.
